outliers.video_title: Greg Lehman - Is Staying Up to Date Overrated?
outliers.why_it_worked: The title challenges a deeply held assumption in the medical and rehab community — that staying current with research is essential — which creates instant cognitive dissonance for the target audience. Dropping a credible expert name (Greg Lehman, a well-known pain science clinician) signals this isn't clickbait but a legitimate provocative claim worth investigating. The question format leaves the answer unresolved, forcing the viewer to click to resolve the tension.
outliers.trend_or_evergreen: evergreen — the debate between evidence-based practice and clinical experience is a permanent tension in rehab and doesn't expire with news cycles
outliers.rewritten_title: Is All That Rotator Cuff Research Actually Helping You Recover Faster?
outliers.rewritten_hook: Open with: 'Most people recovering from a rotator cuff injury are drowning in conflicting advice from studies — but what if following the latest research is actually slowing you down?'
